items.question: What are the benefits of partnering with an EOR?
items.answer: Working with an Employer of Record (EOR) provides clear advantages: simplified compliance, minimized risk, improved HR processes, access to global talent, and greater workforce flexibility. Thinkwires absorbs local labor law liabilities, files statutory taxes, and provisions comprehensive benefits so you scale without administrative overhead.

items.question: How can EOR help my business grow internationally?
items.answer: An EOR drives business growth through local expertise, strict compliance, streamlined payroll and benefits, and effective risk management. Instead of spending 6–9 months and $50k+ creating regional legal subsidiaries in India, North America, or the GCC, Thinkwires enables day-five deployment of verified engineering teams using our existing legal infrastructure.

items.question: How do I pick the right EOR partner for my business?
items.answer: Choosing the ideal EOR partner entails evaluating their physical regional presence, technology portal capabilities, multi-currency processing rails, responsiveness of candidate support, and verified compliance certifications (such as ISO 27001 and SOC 2 Type II). Thinkwires pairs on-the-ground presence in Noida HQ, San Francisco, and Toronto with 24/7 dedicated account directors.

items.question: How does IP ownership and non-disclosure work under an EOR?
items.answer: Intellectual Property ownership is strictly guarded via bi-lateral and tri-partite employment contracts. Under Thinkwires EOR covenants, all contractor inventions, source code, patents, and technical artifacts are automatically assigned directly to your company upon creation, supported by strict institutional NDAs valid in international jurisdictions.

faqs.question: What is staff augmentation and how does it differ from traditional hiring?
faqs.answer: Staff augmentation is a flexible hiring model where you add skilled technical specialists directly to your existing internal team on a project basis. Unlike traditional hiring, it allows you to scale up capacity quickly without long-term severance commitments, costly benefits packages, or multi-month recruitment delays. You maintain full operational control over daily sprints and technical direction, while Thinkwires manages HR, compliance, payroll, and infrastructure support.

faqs.question: How quickly can you provide staff augmentation resources?
faqs.answer: Our active bench allows us to deploy pre-vetted engineers (Full-Stack, Cloud, Data) in as little as 48 hours. For specialized or bespoke architectural skill sets, our talent network connects you with vetted profiles typically within 1 to 2 weeks.

faqs.question: What are the cost benefits compared to full-time hiring?
faqs.answer: Staff augmentation eliminates overhead costs associated with full-time staff—such as benefits packages, local payroll taxes, high-spec hardware provisioning, workspace leases, and onboarding overhead. You only pay for active engineering hours, reducing effective engineering costs by up to 40% compared to onshore full-time equivalents.

faqs.question: How do you ensure the quality and cultural fit of augmented staff?
faqs.answer: We run a 4-tier evaluation: technical assessments, live code architecture reviews, background checks, and spoken communication/cultural fit interviews. You receive transparent candidate summaries and interview each resource directly prior to onboarding. If an engineer is not the right fit, we provide a replacement within 5 working days.

faqs.question: Can we scale up or down the augmented team as project needs change?
faqs.answer: Yes. One of the core benefits of our engagement model is agility. You can add engineers for critical sprints or reduce squad size with a standard 15-day notice period. This protects your runway while giving you elasticity to tackle roadmap milestones.

faqs.question: What is the difference between permanent staffing and temporary staffing?
faqs.answer: Permanent staffing focuses on placing candidates in full-time, long-term positions directly on your corporate payroll, whereas temporary or augmented staffing deploys external specialists for designated project lifecycles. Permanent placements involve exhaustive cultural fit evaluation, long-term equity/compensation design, and succession planning, making them ideal for building core, highly committed organizational teams.

faqs.question: How long does the permanent recruitment process typically take?
faqs.answer: Timelines depend on domain rarity and seniority. For core engineering and managerial roles, Thinkwires delivers qualified shortlists within 7–14 business days, with final placement completed in 2–4 weeks. Specialized C-suite or VP searches typically require 6–10 weeks to accommodate discreet passive talent engagement, deep multi-stakeholder interviews, and executive notice periods.

faqs.question: What industries and roles do you specialize in?
faqs.answer: We specialize in deep technology verticals: Enterprise SaaS, Banking & FinTech, Life Sciences, Cloud Infrastructure, Telecommunications, and Global Capability Centers (GCCs). Our role expertise spans Principal Architects, Engineering Managers, Data Science Leads, SAP/ERP Champions, Product Leaders, CISOs, VPs of Engineering, and C-suite officers (CTO, CIO).

faqs.question: Do you offer a guarantee on permanent placements?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every permanent placement executed by Thinkwires is safeguarded by our formal 90-day replacement guarantee. In the uncommon event that a placed leader departs or fails to meet documented competency objectives within 90 calendar days, Thinkwires immediately initiates an expedited search and delivers a fully qualified replacement at zero additional placement fee.

faqs.question: How do you ensure cultural fit for permanent positions?
faqs.answer: Cultural alignment is assessed quantitatively through structured behavioral models and qualitative situational analysis. Before sourcing candidates, we immerse our recruitment leads into your executive cadence, core leadership values, and operating velocity. Candidates are rigorously tested for work ethic, ambiguity handling, feedback receptiveness, and management style before board presentation.
